name: Appartement Greier
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The **Appartement Greier** is located in a quiet residential area in **Tirol**, Austria. The holiday apartment features a cozy setup with a separate living area, kitchen, and balcony offering stunning mountain views. Guests will enjoy a private accommodation with access to hiking and biking trails nearby. Its central location makes it ideal for exploring the scenic **Tiroler Alpen** landscape. Parking spaces are available.
